title: Fennel and the Big Yellow Excited
subtitle: A story about feeling excited
story: Tomorrow was the Fair! Hooray, hooray!
Fennel could not wait for the big, big day!
top
He counted his coins. He brushed his hair.
He was so excited he danced on the stair!
top
At bedtime, a yellow spark went POP!
It bounced on his pillow, hop, hop, hop!
top
More sparks came bouncing round and round,
bouncing off the walls with a boing-y sound.
top
The Big Yellow Excited filled the room.
Fennel bounced on the bed. Zoom, zoom, ZOOM!
top
His toys went flying. His pillow too.
“I can’t lie down!” he said. “What do I do?”
top
Papa Bear came and sat on the bed.
“Excited is big,” the kind bear said.
top
“First, WIGGLE it out! Shake your paws, shake your knees!”
Fennel wiggled and giggled and shook like the breeze.
top
“Next, BREATHE. Puff your tummy up big and round,
then let the air out with a soft, whooshy sound.”
top
“Last, WAIT. Make a countdown. Cross off the night.
Tomorrow is coming. Tonight, hold on tight.”
top
The sparks bounced slower, and slower, then slept.
Fennel cuddled in close, and a sweet dream crept.
top
Next day at the Fair, with its lights shining bright,
Fennel wiggled and breathed and he waited just right.
top
steps: Shake it out! Wiggle and jump.
Puff your tummy up, then let it out.
Make a countdown. Waiting can be fun.
steps_closing: Big days are worth the wait.
note_lines: Let your child move first, then breathe together.
Make a simple countdown with stickers or stars.
Praise the waiting, not just the event.
cover_blurb: But a bouncy Big Yellow Excited
With a little help from Papa Bear,
A warm rhyming story for ages 3–6,

listing.description:
Tomorrow is the Fair! Hooray, hooray! But at bedtime, a yellow spark goes POP... and then another... and another.

The Big Yellow Excited bounces on the pillow, off the walls, and all over Fennel's bed, until Papa Bear sits beside him and shows him how to settle his sparks.

With three calm steps — Wiggle. Breathe. Wait. — little readers learn that excited is a good feeling that can feel very big, and that waiting can be fun.

Inside this warm rhyming picture book:

  • A bouncy read-aloud rhyme for ages 3–6, perfect for the night before a big day
  • A kid-friendly image of excitement as bouncy yellow sparks that slow down and sleep
  • Three easy steps children can copy: Wiggle, Breathe, Wait
  • A note for grown-ups with simple ways to help an over-excited child
  • Soft watercolor-style illustrations

Book 7 in the Fennel's Feelings series. Great for bedtime, birthdays, holidays, and trips.

Style: soft watercolor and gouache children's picture book, warm cozy palette, subtle paper texture. The setting is Fennel's cozy cottage bedroom and living room (wooden bed, patchwork quilt, bedside lamp, window with floral curtains) at night, and a village fair with a Ferris wheel the next day. At night Fennel wears soft blue striped pajamas. The 'excitement' is a cloud of bouncy, glowing yellow sparks like little round springy balls of warm yellow light that bounce around (never a monster, no face); they get calmer and slower and finally rest like sleeping fireflies. No text, letters or words anywhere in the image (no signs, labels or writing on anything).
